Page 002
002-1. SOME PEOPLE TURN THEIR LIVES AROUND AFTER GETTING A NEWRANK,BUT THE MAJORITY DON'T.
002-2. IN FACT, ALL THE HUNTERS WHO GET PLACED IND-RANK ARE SCOUTED BY THOSE AGENTS OVER THERE.
002-3. AGENTS?
002-4. YEAH,THEY'RE FROMDIFFERENT GUILDS.
002-5. BUT THEY'RE FROM THE ONES THAT DON'T GET ALOT OF APPLICANTS,SO THEY WAIT HERE AND TRY TORECRUIT NEWLYEVALUATED HUNTERS.

Page 003
003-1. YOU'RE BETTER OFF STAYING AWAY FROM GUILDS LIKE THAT, THOUGH.
003-2. I HEARD THAT SMALL GUILDS GO ONALOT OF DANGEROUS RAIDS, SO THE MORTALITY RATEIS SUPER HIGH.
003-3. I GUESS THAT'S TO BE EXPECTED, SINCE SMALL GUILDS DON'T HAVE THE RIGHT FOOTING.
003-4. THEY PROBABLY AREN'T SATISFIED WITH TARGETING LOW-RANKING DUNGEONS LIKE PRIVATE STRIKE SQUADS DO,
003-5. BUT THEY DON'T HAVE THE SKILLS TO RAID HIGH-RANKING DUNGEONS, EITHER. THAT'S WHY THEY GET INTO SO MANY ACCIDENTS.
003-6. THERE WEREN'T ANY BACK IN MY DAY...
003-7. NEXT, PLEASE COME INSIDE.
003-8. SLOUCH.
003-9. ICAN'T BELIEVE IT...

Page 004
004-1. NO NEED TO BE NERVOUS. JUST LOWERYOUR EXPECTATIONS.
004-2. AS LONG AS YOU DON'T GET PLACED IN E-RANK,YOU'LLBE ABLE TO MAKE A BASIC LIVING.
004-3. IFIGET INTO A MAJOR GUILD,I'LL GETA DOWNPAYMENT AFTER SIGNING THE AFTERSIGNING THE CONTRACT CONTRACT.
004-4. MAYBEICAN FINALLY PAY OFF MY DEBT WITH THAT MONEY,
004-5. NIBBLE
004-6. NIBBLE
004-7. AND LIVE WITH MY DAUGHTER AGAIN.

Page 005
005-1. I HAVE TO GET C-RANK...
005-2. C-RANK OR ABOVE IS WHAT INEED.
005-3. MANY PEOPLE'S LIVES CHANGE DUE TO THEIR RANK.
005-4. A HUNTER'S RANK DETERMINES HOW POWERFUL THEY ARE.
005-5. A HUNTER COULD SPEND YEARS PRACTICING SWORD FIGHTING AND BUILDING UP THEIR BODY,
005-6. BUT THE DIFFERENCE IN RANKS CANNOT BE EASILY OVERCOME.
005-7. THERE ARE HUGE DIFFERENCES IN INCOME AS WELL.
005-8. MR.SONG WAS ANEXPERIENCED

006-1. SWORDSMAN,
006-2. BUT HIS SKILLS WERE NO MATCH FOR KANG TAESHIK,WHO HAD A HIGHER RANK.
006-3. THE SAME GOES FOR ME.I'VE NEVERBEEN ABLE TO RISE ABOVE MY RANK EVEN THOUGH I'VE BEEN GOING ON RAIDS FOR YEARS.
006-4. CLENCH
006-5. BUT THINGS ARE DIFFERENT NOW...!
006-6. GLOOM

007-2. TREMBLE

007-8. HEY, WOULD YOU LIKE TO GO FIRST?
007-9. SURE,OKAY.

Page 008
008-1. WHAT'S YOUR NAME?
008-2. MY NAMEIS SUNG JINWOO.
008-3. OH HE'S ALREADY BEEN EVALUATED. HE AWAKENED AS AN E-RANK.
008-4. ARE YOU HERE FOR A RE-EVALUATION?
008-5. YES.

Page 009

Page 010

010-2. I'M SORRY. LET ME TRY ONE MORE TIME.
010-3. BEEP
010-4. BEEP
010-5. WHAT THE HECKIS WRONG WITH THIS MACHINE?
010-6. PRESS PRESS

Page 011
011-1. HE WENT TO THE RESTROOM.
011-2. THAT PUNK... HE SHOULDN'T LEAVE HIS POST DURING WORKING HOURS...
011-3. ..OH,WAIT. I GUESS I'M DOING THE SAME THING.
011-4. AHEM
011-5. WHAT'S THE MATTER?
011-6. THERE'S SOMETHING WRONG WITH THE MANA METER.
011-7. I CAME HERE OUT OF CURIOSITY BECAUSE BAEK YOONHO MADE SUCH A HUGE FUSS OVER THIS GUY... MAYBE THERE REALLY IS SOMETHING SPECIAL ABOUTHIM?

Page 012
012-1. NAH,WHAT AM I SAYING? A REAWAKENING IS NOT THAT COMMON.
012-2. I THINK IT WAS AROUND THREE MONTHS AGO...
012-3. EVERYONE AT THE ASSOCIATION FREAKED OUT WHEN AN E-RANK HUNTER WAS SUSPECTED TO HAVE REAWAKENED,THE MANAGER OF THE SURVEILLANCE TEAM WENT TO LOOK INTOTHE MATTER HIMSELF,
012-4. BUT IT TURNED OUT TO BE A FALSE ALARM.
012-5. SEE? I KEEP GETTING THIS ERROR MESSAGE.
012-6. RROR
012-7. THERE ARE LOADS OF PEOPLEWHO COME IN THINKING THEYVE REAWAKENED, BUT JUST END UP WASTING THEIR MONEY WONE ON THE TEST FEES AGAIN...

Page 013
013-1. .HOW LONG HAVE YOU BEEN WORKING HERE?
013-2. ABOUT SIX MONTHS NOW...
013-3. DIDIPRESS THE WRONG BUTTON?
013-4. SIX MONTHS, EH...2
013-5. IT'S BEEN TWO YEARS SINCE CHA HAE-IN WAS EVALUATED,SO OF COURSE SHE DOESN'T KNOW!
013-6. NO, JUST GO GET CHANGSHIK.
013-7. SORRY?
013-8. EVEN I FAILED TO NOTICE UNTIL NOW. THIS IS WHY I NEVER GET PROMOTED!
013-9. I DON'T CARE IF HE'S USING THE RESTROOM.JUST GO GET HIM!

Page 014
014-1. BUTHE'S IN THE MEN'S RESTROOM..! WH,WHAT'S GOING ON, MR.JUNG?
014-2. THIS ISN'T JUST AN ERROR.THE MANA METERISINCAPABLE OF EVALUATING HIM! DON'T YOUKNOW WHAT THAT MEANS?
014-3. IT MEANS THAT OUR METER ISN'T POWERFUL ENOUGH TO MEASURE HIS MANALEVELS!
014-4. WHAT? TH, THEN COULD HE BE...?

Page 015
015-1. COULDHE BE KOREA'S 1OTH..!
015-2. THAT'S RIGHT...
015-3. HE'SAN S-RANK,

Page 016
016-1. MR.WOO.
016-2. ABOUT MR.HWANG'S SUDDENVISIT TO KOREA...
016-3. IS IT TRUE THAT HE DIDN'T HAVE ANYTHING TO DO WITH THE RECENT RED GATE INCIDENT?
016-4. YES, HWANG DONGSOO IS NOT THE HUNTER WHOHELPED THE SURVIVORS.
016-5. ICAN ASSURE YOU,SIR. I WAS THERE THAT DAY.
016-6. yn W
016-7. SO THAT MEANS YOU KNOW WHO IT ACTUALLYWAS.

Page 017
017-1. I DON'T KNOW THE DETAILS,SIR,BECAUSE I DIDN'T STAY UNTIL THE VERY END.
017-2. HOWEVER,THERE IS SOMEONE I SUSPECT...
017-3. THE RESULTS WERE CONCLUSIVE.WHY AM I THINKING ABOUT THAT AGAIN...
017-4. I SEE YOU CHOOSE GEEYOUCHOOEE NOT TO SHARE YOUR THOUGHTSUNTIL YOU'VE GATHERED ALL THE FACTS.
017-5. I UNDERSTAND.
017-6. I'MMORE INTERESTED IN THE WINGED ANT THAT WASHED UP ASHORE IN JAPAN.

Page 018
018-1. SO FAR,IT'S JUST ONE CORPSE, BUT IF WINGED ANTS COULD INDEED FLY TO OTHER COUNTRIES FROM JEJU ISLAND...
018-2. NO,ACTUALLY, EVEN BEFORE THAT HAPPENS, HUNTERS FROMEVERY GUILD WILLBE DRAFTED.
018-3. ISEE.
018-4. ALL OF US FROM THE HUNTERS GUILD WILL COOPERATE.
018-5. OH, THERE SEEMS TO BE QUITEA BIT OFNOISE COMING FROM BUILDINGB TODAY.
018-6. FROM BUILDINGB, SIR?
018-7. IDON'T HEAR ANYTHING...

Page 019
019-1. I'MALITTLE SENSITIVE TO THESE THINGS.
019-2. IT'S PROBABLYAHUNTER CAUSING ASCENE DURING THEIR EVALUATION.
019-3. I'LLGO AND CHECK.
019-4. CHSSS
019-5. I WANT TO SEE FOR MYSELF.
019-6. IS HE PICKING UP ON SOMETHING AGAIN

Page 020
020-1. BECAUSE HE HAS SUCH A GENTLE FACE,
020-2. I FORGOT WHO HE WAS FOR A MOMENT.
020-3. LET ME JOIN YOU.
020-4. UM...ACCORDING TO THE MACHINE, YOUR...
020-5. I MEAN, MR. SUNG, YOUR MANA LEVELS ARE UNMEASURABLE.

Page 021
021-1. TO USE A MORE ADVANCED MANA METER, WE NEED PERMISSION FROM THE HIGHER-UPS. COULD YOU COME BACK IN THREE DAYS?
021-2. A PENDING EVALUATION!
021-3. I JUST HEARD TUGT HEARE THEM SAY HE WAS UNMEASURABLE...!
021-4. DOES THAT MEAN THAT GUY IS AN S-RANK2
021-5. I CAN'T BELIEVE I'M ACTUALLY WITNESSING THIS...
021-6. HE MUST BE KOREA'S 1OTH S-RANK HUNTER...!
021-7. SMALL GUILDS LIKE US CAN'T RECRUIT A GUY LIKE THAT!

Page 022
022-1. SHOULD I JUST GO AND ASK HIM?!
022-2. BUT MAYBE THIS IS A GOLDEN OPPORTUNITY.
022-3. H...HEY, PLEASE EVALUATE ME, TOO!
022-4. UH... ALL RIGHT!
022-5. I HAVE THE POWER OF PERSUASION THAT'S SECOND TO NONE...
022-6. DOES OUR GUILD EVEN HAVE ENOUGH FUNDS TO RECRUIT AN S-RANK HUNTER...?!
022-7. HUH?IS THAT...?!
022-8. OH, MY GOD!

Page 023
023-1. HE'S THE MASTER OF KOREA'SFINEST GUILD,
023-2. THE "HUNTERS"!!
023-3. 1,IT'S CHOI JONG-IN!
023-4. WHATIS "THE ULTIMATE HUNTER"DOING HERE?!
